## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) and VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%) confirm risk appetite, with Stocks vs Bonds rising (Level: 7.8559, ↑ rising) as a second independent confirmation.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Stocks vs Bonds rising (Level: 7.8559, ↑ rising) and VXX falling (VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%)) signal fear easing; credit stress is a caveat as Credit Spread (Level: 0.7322, → flat) ticked up and HYG (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND shows mixed signals.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Dollar weakening: UUP (Level proxy, 1W: -1.40% | 1M: -0.87%) BELOW TREND and TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.35%) point to looser conditions supporting risk assets.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Growth/momentum leadership: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.84% | 1M: +13.08%) showing strength, XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.07% | 1M: +4.72%) confirming cyclicals; XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) showing short-term weakness.

5. US vs Global?  
US strong: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%); EM leadership resurging with EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.02% | 1M: +2.94%) while China FXI in RECOVERY (1W: +1.94% | 1M: -0.41%).

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Mixed but elevated risk-on: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +3.72%) and ETHA ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.09% | 1M: +8.67%) show speculative flows even as the Speculation Index is falling (Level: 0.1020, ↓ falling) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Base metals and reflation signs: CPER RECOVERY (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.69%) and Copper/Gold ratio ↑ rising support cyclical demand, while oil ETFs show short-term profit-taking — USO in CORRECTION (1W: -9.50% | 1M: +15.52%).

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy under pressure: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) and UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%) highlight sector weakness despite mixed 1M oil readings (BNO CORRECTION (1W: -12.69% | 1M: +7.29%)).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) and XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%) show multi-timeframe confirmation; major divergence in energy commodities (USO and BNO 1W negative vs 1M positive) is a MAJOR DIVERGENCE to monitor.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor growth/momentum exposure via XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.84% | 1M: +13.08%) while reducing exposure to energy-risk via XLE CORRECTION (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) and UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.84% | 1M: +13.08%), XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.07% | 1M: +4.72%).  
BEARISH: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%), UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%).

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: CPER RECOVERY (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.69%) and industrial metals given Copper/Gold ↑ rising.  
BEARISH: USO CORRECTION (1W: -9.50% | 1M: +15.52%) and BNO CORRECTION (1W: -12.69% | 1M: +7.29%) — watch oil volatility.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~30 (current 30.77) — complacency/volatility pivot; Credit Spread ~0.73 (current 0.7322, → flat) — widening is a risk signal; Stocks vs Bonds ~7.86 (current 7.8559, ↑ rising) — monitor for persistence; Tech/Fin ratio ~2.81 (current 2.8091, ↑ rising) — watch for rotation if it rolls over.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive.  
Technology and semis showing strength (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.84% | 1M: +13.08%)).  
Key risk: credit spread widening and energy/commodity divergences (USO CORRECTION (1W: -9.50% | 1M: +15.52%), Credit Spread Level: 0.7322, → flat) to monitor.
